 A Boogie Wit da Hoodie expands 2026 tour with six new dates
 Date posted: 
 October 28, 2026 
 A Boogie Wit da Hoodie has added six more headlining shows to his 2026 touring schedule, extending his year-end run into December. The new run follows previously announced performances, including A Boogie’s two sold-out shows at UBS Arena in Elmont, New York, on Oct. 29-30 celebrating the 10th anniversary of his 2016 debut mixtape, “Artist.”
 A Boogie began his milestone year with a sold-out Boogie Bash at Radio City Music Hall and released the six-track EP “Before Artistry” in February, featuring “Glitchin,” “Show Me Something Real,” “PGD” and “Red Light.”
 The newly added shows are scheduled for Nov. 7 at Agganis Arena in Boston, Nov. 14 in Philadelphia at The Liacouras Center, Nov. 28 in Toronto at Scotiabank Arena, Dec. 5 in Orlando at the Orlando Amphitheater, Dec. 12 in Minneapolis at The Armory and Dec. 19 in Hartford, Connecticut, at PeoplesBank Arena.  Select dates will feature support from BabyChiefDoit, Cash Cobain, DaBaby, G Herbo, J.I the Prince, Moneybagg Yo, NTG, Yung Miami and Zeddy Will.
 Head to TICKETMASTER for info.
